title: evalharness coverage record
description: One record per run of one arm: what the run covered and what the pre-flight checks found. A value the run did not produce is null, never 0 or an empty string.

schema_version.description: The version of this coverage contract. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

arm.description: The label of the configuration under test, as in the result records.

case_set_sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 over the sorted case ids and their definitions, so two runs on different case sets cannot pass as comparable.

cases_defined.description: The number of cases in the case set.

cases_run.description: The number of cases the arm ran. This is the headline denominator.

cases_judged.description: The number of cases with an overall of pass or fail. Per-criterion detail has its own denominator: the cases where that criterion is pass or fail.

clock.description: The clock the fixtures saw during the run.

pinned_at.description: The UTC time the fixture clock was pinned to, as an RFC 3339 date-time with a Z or +00:00 offset. Null when the run used the live clock.

source.description: Where the pinned time came from. Null when the run used the live clock.

fixture_manifest_sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the fixture manifest the run used. Null when the run used no fixtures.

checks.description: Every pre-flight check and its result. A warning lives here, never only in printed output.

result.description: ok: the check passed. warn: the run went ahead and the warning is recorded. refuse: the check stopped the run.

reason.description: Why the check gave its result. Null when the check gave no reason.

commit.description: The commit under test. Null when the run was not from a commit.
